description: This file defines the ModuleAttribute class, a custom attribute used to annotate assemblies with module metadata such as author, version, website, tags, and dependencies within the OrchardCore framework.

classes.name: ModuleAttribute
classes.description: A custom attribute class for defining module metadata in OrchardCore, extending FeatureAttribute, with properties like Type, Author, Website, Version, and Tags, and multiple constructors for flexible initialization.

methods.name: GetAttributePrefix
methods.description: Static method to derive the default module type name by removing the 'Attribute' suffix from the class name.

methods.name: ParseTags
methods.description: Private static method to parse a delimited string of tags into a trimmed string array.
